nodes.name: Workspace packages
nodes.responsibility: Reusable libraries that the applications reach only through their package exports.
nodes.description: A package owns one behavior and names its public files in package.json exports; nothing imports an app. Each package sits in a layer: the longest chain of packages it imports. A package imports only layers below its own, and packages of one layer never import each other (tests/system/repository-policy/package-graph.test.ts holds both rules). The apps share layer 8 above them all.

nodes.name: Layer 5
nodes.responsibility: Imports only the layers below it, 0 to 4
nodes.description: Holds renderer, code-intel, codex-app-server. A package's layer is the longest chain of packages it imports.

nodes.name: Layer 6
nodes.responsibility: Imports only the layers below it, 0 to 5
nodes.description: Holds server-lifecycle, code-opener, walkthrough, codex-realtime-voice. A package's layer is the longest chain of packages it imports.

nodes.name: Layer 7
nodes.responsibility: Imports only the layers below it, 0 to 6
nodes.description: Holds workbench, skills. A package's layer is the longest chain of packages it imports.

nodes.name: codex-app-server
nodes.responsibility: One private Codex app-server session over stdio

nodes.name: workbench
nodes.responsibility: Archboard's host of the voice package: board context, domain tools, narration, pane routing, and the visual workbench shell

nodes.name: codex-realtime-voice
nodes.responsibility: The public MIT voice agent: one host entry for a server and one browser client, over Codex sessions, a coordinator, checkout workhorses and the host's own identity and policy
nodes.description: Its npm build bundles codex-app-server, process, timing and diagnostics, which are MIT like it; every other workspace package is BUSL and stays out of it. Archboard and the example reach it only through the entries an outside host uses.

nodes.name: Workbench example
nodes.responsibility: An independent host on Bun.serve that uses only the voice package's public entries, without a board or vault
